storage_and_schedule_contract: All calls are serialized on the owning thread with live, accessible, disjoint raw clock and consumer storage. R38 profile checks do not prove allocation size or pointer lifetime.
Raw current providers independently reload the same publication on each call; they do not retain the returned raw owner pointer across calls.
Snapshots contain only16 timestamp bytes. The caller must consume the result before another provider call or adapter retirement. Publication changes alone do not update the previous snapshot.
